messages:
Harper: quick poll: whos the bigger drama queenYAML with a sneaky space, or Semver dropping a midnight major? :popcorn:
Leo: YAML. Its passive-aggressive. A single space and everything ghosts you. :ghost:
Ivy: Semver is theatrical. Announces itself with a 500 and disappears. :performing_arts:
Harper: also true story: my last PR had a hyphen that looked fine but CI screamed.
ci-bot: CI: :warning: lint failed - parse error in ops/deploy.yaml: sequence item expected at line 14
Harper: culprit snippet:
```yaml
deploy:
  - service: web
    replicas: 2
    env:
     - name: MODE
       value: prod
    - name: DEBUG
      value: "false"
```
Leo: that extra dash before DEBUG is out here living its best life.
Ivy: New team rule proposal: broken YAML -> you bring breakfast. Repeats -> lunch. Major bumps without notice -> you sponsor coffee for the week. :coffee:
Harper: loving the carrot approach. Also can we have a "Semver Apology" card template? Ill print it.
ci-bot: :white_check_mark: added yaml-lint to CI pipeline and a polite nudge message for first-time offenders.
Leo: also, who wants stickers: "I survived a YAML merge" or "I apologize, it was semver v2.0.0"?
Ivy: both. stick them next to the espresso machine as a public service announcement.
Harper: voted. Meme attached (do not click if you are fragile): https://imgur.com/fake-meme-please-ignore :rofl:
Leo: saving for onboarding. Also implementing lint-before-merge as a soft rule.
Ivy: closing poll: YAML 2, Semver 1. YAML wins by stealth formatting.
